name: Avocado & Quinoa Salad with Edamame & Cranberries
steps: Cook the quinoa: add to a pot with double the volume of water. Bring to a boil, reduce to low, cover and simmer 15–20 minutes until water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork.
Thaw the edamame by warming on the stove or in the microwave.
Make the dressing: whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, mustard, salt and pepper. Add lemon zest for extra flavour.
Halve and slice the avocado. In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, spinach, edamame, dried cranberries, sunflower seeds and avocado. Pour dressing over and toss gently.

nutrition_per_serving.source: estimated — no scaling, same as base recipe

notes: Dinner only (2 servings). Protein is lighter at 22g — consider a protein shake or Greek yogurt snack to supplement.
